sensor_calibration.required_outcome_pattern: ^(?!.*(?:同步|时差|时间偏|时间戳|时钟|clock|synchron|time offset)).*(?:(?:标定|校准)(?!板)|calibrate(?:\s|$))
sensor_calibration.description: Estimate and independently validate sensor extrinsics when the user requests calibration.

clock_calibration.required_outcome_pattern: 同步|时差|时间偏|时钟|clock|synchron|time offset
clock_calibration.description: Measure bounded LiDAR-to-camera acquisition time offsets from observations of a manually moving board and verify on held-out motion.

object_observation.description: Locate or recognize a visual object in the current camera scene.
